current_flow: The board serves epics/stories with a story drawer (plan, gate rail, artifacts) and derives next_actions by re-parsing cmd_next output; it has no per-task view. task_frontier_state returns only the single frontier action plus its task; grill freshness (grounding_digest compare) and budget counting (review_budget plus the numstat walk) exist but have no all-tasks consumer. A dev reading the board cannot see which task is skeleton/ready/grilled/active/done, whether the grill is fresh, or how much budget the active stage has used.

criteria_map.board task rows match task_frontier_stat: test_board_task_rows_match_frontier_states drives one fixture per state and asserts row state equals the routing state
criteria_map.existing board tests green: the board test group runs in the affected selection; test_board_task_rows_show_grill_freshness_and_budget covers the new columns without touching existing assertions

new_abstractions: task_rows(root) in factory_lib - task_frontier_state deliberately returns only the single next action, and the board needs every task's state; building rows on top of the same primitives (statuses, contract-field presence, grounding_digest compare, review_budget) is the only way routing and board cannot disagree. Reversible: read-only derivation, one function.
